verdict.rationale: Runpod documents creating Pods from the console or CLI (`runpodctl pod create`) and via the REST and GraphQL APIs. Its get-started guide promises running code on a remote GPU in minutes, with templates that are ready instantly and access via SSH, JupyterLab, or VS Code. Community users corroborate deploying in a few clicks and getting H100s easily, though one reports low GPU availability and occasional failed boots. Missing for 10: consistent evidence of reliable capacity and boot success for in-demand GPU types.
